title: Cloud Developer
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
  
  
****Who We Are:****
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
****Job Description:****
In the
**HPE Hybrid Cloud**
, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
****What You Will Do:****

* Design, develop, and maintain Network Topology Management (NTM) accuracy and reliability along with Network configuration Managagement (NCM).
* Build and optimize topology discovery and processing pipelines for L2 and L3 relationships.
* Debugging and resolve topology defects.
* Improve topology reconciliation, graph consistency, and end-to-end observability.
* Collaborate with backend, frontend, network domain, SRE, and product teams to deliver NTM-first solutions.
* Build operational tooling and diagnostics for fast root-cause analysis in distributed systems.
* Work on Network Configuration Management , including backup, compliance, remediation, and restore reliability.
* Improve user-facing workflows for topology and configuration operations in UI experiences.
* Support production readiness through testing, monitoring, performance tuning, and incident response.
* Identify and drive improvements in reliability, scalability, and maintainability of NTM and NCM systems.
* Design and develop vast and various Network topologies in virtual using different tools like Netlab, Containerlab, etc

****What You Will Need:****

* 3+ -8 years of software engineering experience in scalable enterprise systems.
* Strong programming skills in Java and/or Python and/or go.
* Good understanding of distributed systems and event-driven architecture patterns.
* Strong networking fundamentals including SNMP, CLI workflows, SSH or Telnet, and L2 or L3 concepts.
* Strong understanding of Network protocols like LLDP, CDP, OSPF, BGP, IPsec, etc.
* Hands on experience with any of network device os like Arista (EOS), Cisco (NXOS, IOS, XE-IOS), Juniper (Junos), Aruba, etc.
* Hands on experience with tools like Docker, Containerlab, Netlab, postman, etc.
* Must have knowledge on SNMP Domain skills and hands on experience with network devices CLI.
* Experience with APIs, asynchronous workflows, and data processing pipelines.
* Experience debugging production issues across service, data, and UI layers.
* Ability to design robust retry, failure handling, and recovery mechanisms.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with focus on operational impact and customer outcomes.
* AI-First engineering.

****Good To Have:****

* Experience with network discovery and topology reconciliation at scale.
* Hands-on exposure to React and TypeScript for operational UI integrations.
* Experience with observability tools for logs, metrics, and traces.
* Experience with performance tuning and reliability engineering.
* Familiarity with security-first engineering in multi-tenant systems.
* Open-source contributions, technical blogs, or architecture notes in networking or distributed systems.

****Additional Skills:****

* Cloud Architectures
* Cross Domain Knowledge
* Design Thinking
* Development Fundamentals
* Microservices Fluency
* Full Stack Development

****Additional Skills:****

* AI-First Engineering Skills including thorough understanding of at least one coding harness, AI-SDLC principles with workflows, Agents/Subagents, and Skills.
* Must be creative in adopting emerging AI-Skills in day-2-day workflows for SDLC and product support including monitoring and root-cause analysis of the workflows themselves to improve continuously.

**Accessibility**
HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
  
  
Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
  
  
****What We Can Offer You:****
**Health & Wellbeing**
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
  
  
**Personal & Professional Development**
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
  
  
**Unconditional Inclusion**
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
  
  
****Let's Stay Connected:****
Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

title: Developer IV
description:
**Overview**
As a Full Stack Developer who is Backend heavy, you’ll be part of an agile product team delivering new features to a suite of sustainability applications for our Payments, FinTech team. It owns Shared Wallet, a high-impact initiative covering tokenization of payment accounts, digital wallet (Apple Pay) APIs, offline payor capabilities, and related payment services. You will join a small pod as its senior technical lead.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own technical design for Shared Wallet services, from architecture through rollout, and make and document key design decisions.
* Serve as the senior reviewer on pull requests, setting the bar for code quality, security, and test coverage.
* Lead resolution of complex production and integration issues across payment flows, using centralized logging and reporting to diagnose and prevent recurrence.
* Mentor the Developer I and Developer II on the team, including design reviews, pairing, and career growth.
* Partner with product, QA, architecture, and security on scope, estimates, and delivery, and keep the pod's commitments predictable.
* Build and ship features hands-on; this is a working lead role, not a management role.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong
* C# and .NET Core backend development.
* Proven experience designing, building, and owning production REST APIs on .NET Core.
* Hands-on experience with AWS and DynamoDB, including data modeling for NoSQL access patterns.
* Experience designing distributed, API-based systems with attention to reliability, idempotency, and failure handling.
* Experience with centralized logging, monitoring, and reporting for production support.
* Hands-on experience in payments or financial services (card/ACH processing, tokenization, PSP or gateway integrations, or digital wallets).
* Working knowledge of secure development for regulated data, ideally PCI DSS.
* Strong track record of code review, technical mentoring, and raising a team's engineering standards.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting designs for cross-team review.

**Nice To Have**




+ Experience with Azure DevOps.
+ FinTech background or payments domain experience
+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
+ Infrastructure as code, observability, and incident response practices.

title: Developer II
description:
**Overview**
As a Software Developer II on the Smart Water pod, you will build the customer-facing Smart Water experience inside the RealPage Smart Building Portal and the services behind it. You will work across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL, integrating meter and usage data from upstream systems.
  
  
A core part of the mission is making Smart Water scale: replacing today's manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service workflows, hardening the data-ingestion pipeline, and building water-usage anomaly detection that flags running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, and abnormal consumption for operators.
  
  
This role suits a developer with a few years of full-stack experience who wants to own medium-sized features end to end in a small, high-ownership pod and grow into the product's AI roadmap (a Smart Water MCP that powers a Lumina Copilot).
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Smart Water features across an Angular front end and C#/.NET 8 Web APIs over MSSQL.
* Integrate meter, usage, and occupancy data from upstream systems and improve the reliability of the ingestion pipeline.
* Develop water-usage anomaly detection that surfaces sustained anomalies (running toilets, continuous-flow fixtures, abnormal usage) from interval meter data.
* Replace manual, PME-driven onboarding with automated, self-service setup and data-management workflows.
* Surface Smart Water inside the Smart Building Portal (SBP) and contribute to the Smart Water MCP that powers Lumina AI workflows.
* Write clean, well-tested code and partner closely with the pod's QA engineer on quality and data integrity.

**Qualifications**
This is a full-stack role on a C#/.NET 8 and Angular codebase backed by MSSQL.
  
  

* 2+ years building production software, full- stack or backend-leaning.
* Proficiency in C#/.NET (ASP.NET Web API) and solid SQL / relational data-modeling skills (MSSQL).
* Front-end experience with Angular or a similar modern framework.
* Experience integrating and consuming REST APIs and working with upstream/third-party data sources.
* Comfort writing tested, maintainable code and working in a CI/CD workflow (Azure DevOps).
* Extensive hands-on experience with Claude Code or a similar agentic coding harness (required).
* Demonstrated experience with agentic coding workflows — using AI coding agents as part of day-to-day development (required).

**Preferred Required**
**Preferred Skills but not required**

* Experience with data-pipeline / ingestion work and diagnosing data-quality issues.
* Exposure to IoT, metering, or utility/submetering domains.
* Experience with ElasticSearch .
* Interest in applied AI — building MCP servers or LLM-powered features (e.g., a Lumina Copilot).
* Familiarity with OIDC / single sign-on integration.

title: Senior Agentic AI Developer
description:
Coretek is looking for an Agentic AI Developer to build production AI agents for our clients. You'll design and ship systems where an LLM plans, calls tools, and acts against real business systems, then you'll make those systems reliable, evaluated, secure, and affordable enough to run in production. This is a hands\-on engineering role in a client\-facing consulting environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and ship agentic AI applications on Azure: multi\-step reasoning, tool and function calling, retrieval, memory, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints
* Implement retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines, including chunking strategy, embedding and indexing, hybrid and semantic search, reranking, and grounding with citations
* Integrate agents with client systems through APIs, databases, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, writing the tool definitions and schemas the model depends on
* Build evaluation harnesses and golden datasets, and treat accuracy, groundedness, and task completion as measured numbers rather than impressions.
* Instrument agents for production: tracing, token and cost telemetry, latency budgets, failure and fallback paths, and alerting on quality regressions
* Implement guardrails and responsible AI controls, covering prompt injection defense, content filtering, PII handling, output validation, and clear boundaries on what an agent is allowed to do without human approval
* Tune cost and latency through model selection, prompt caching, context management, batching, and routing simple work to smaller models
* Apply engineering discipline to AI code: version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and prompt and model versioning
* Containerize and deploy agent services, owning the build, release, scaling, and runtime configuration of what you ship
* Set technical direction on client engagements and mentor junior engineers, establishing patterns and standards the wider team can follow
* Work directly with clients to turn ambiguous business problems into scoped agent use cases, and be honest about what current models can and cannot do reliably
* Partner with Project Managers, data engineers, and application teams to deliver end to end, and document what you build so others can operate it


**Requirements**
* At least 7 years in a software, data, or ML engineering role, with a minimum of 2 years building LLM\-based or agentic applications that reached real users
* Strong hands\-on Python development, with real testing, packaging, and code review practice, not scripting alone
* Practical experience with LLM APIs and agent frameworks, such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or LangGraph.
* Working knowledge of agent design patterns: tool and function calling, structured output, planning and reflection loops, multi\-agent handoffs, and knowing when a deterministic workflow beats an agent
* Experience building RAG systems with a vector or hybrid search store, such as Azure AI Search, PostgreSQL with pgvector, or Cosmos DB
* Prompt engineering depth, including system prompt design, few\-shot strategy, context window management, and systematic iteration against an eval set
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including writing production images, managing configuration and secrets, and deploying and scaling workloads on AKS or equivalent
* Experience deploying and operating services on Azure, such as AKS, Container Apps, Azure Functions, or App Service
* Solid API and data fundamentals: REST, async programming, SQL, and JSON schema design
* Git\-based workflow and experience shipping through CI/CD
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, including non\-technical stakeholders, and to set realistic expectations about AI capability and risk
* Exceptional analytical and debugging skills, including the ability to diagnose why an agent failed when the failure is non\-deterministic and the stack trace is clean
* Strong knowledge and experience in working with customers in a consultative approach in a technical environment


**Additional Qualifications**
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server or client development
* Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tooling, such as Azure AI Foundry evaluations, LangSmith, or OpenTelemetry\-based tracing
* Familiarity with Azure networking, identity, and security requirements, including Managed Identity, Key Vault, and Private Endpoints
* Experience with fine\-tuning, distillation, or small language model deployment
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, or Azure Synapse for the data layer behind AI solutions
* Experience with document intelligence and multimodal inputs, such as Azure AI Document Intelligence, vision, or speech
* Experience in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, DPDP Act) with auditability and data residency requirements
* Infrastructure as code experience (Terraform, Bicep, or Helm)
* Proven ability to manage multiple client projects and deliver high\-quality results on time
* Experience in Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control and pipelines

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. **Position Overview**
 Job Summary
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer – .NET to design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high\-performing applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in C\#, .NET/.NET Core, REST APIs, microservices, SQL, and modern cloud\-based application development.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications using C\# and .NET/.NET Core.
* Develop scalable RESTful APIs and microservices following industry best practices.
* Participate in solution design, technical discussions, code reviews, and architecture decisions.
* Build reliable integrations between applications, databases, and third\-party systems.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well\-tested code.
* Troubleshoot application issues and perform root cause analysis for production problems.
* Optimize application performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
* Implement unit testing and automated testing to maintain high code quality.
* Work with SQL Server and write optimized queries, stored procedures, and database objects.
* Support CI/CD pipelines, source control, and automated deployments.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to coding standards and engineering best practices.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and deliver features within committed timelines.


**Required Skills**
* 7\+ years of software development experience, with strong hands\-on expertise in the Microsoft technology stack.
* Strong programming experience with C\# and .NET/.NET Core.
* Hands\-on experience with ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST APIs, and Microservices.
* Strong understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
* Experience with Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.
* Strong experience with SQL Server, relational databases, and query optimization.
* Experience with Unit Testing frameworks such as NUnit, xUnit, or MSTest.
* Knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Good communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to messaging technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with distributed systems and event\-driven architectures.
* Knowledge of application security, authentication, and authorization using OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect / JWT.
* Experience working on high\-volume transactional or payment applications is an added advantage.
